newsitem.title: USA: Friends-Vilas says to launch "ethical" portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Friends-Vilas says to launch "ethical" portfolio.

text.p: Friends Vilas-Fisher Trust Co said Tuesday it launched the Friends Stewardship Trust Portfolio, an "ethical" fund for U.S. institutional and high net worth individuals.

The "socially responsible" fund, affiliated with the American Friends Service Committee, a Quaker service and relief organization, will invest in companies that are "actively contributing to a better world."

It seeks companies focused on product/service quality and safety; "progressive" environmental and conservation practices; "superior" employee welfare; commitment to "diversity;" global corporate accountability and "support for the community."

The fund will not invest in companies associated with nuclear power; alcohol or tobacco; production or distribution of "offensive or violent portrayals;" environmental damage or pollution; production of animal-tested beauty products; and trade with "oppressive" regimes.
Friends-Vilas manages nearly $2 billion in assets.
